summary: iter-161 Inventory FY-scoping fix VERIFIED WORKING end-to-end. Dashboard tiles show exact expected per-FY values (13,682 items / ₹94,10,388.24 for FY 2026-27; 14 items / ₹14,587.18 for FY 2025-26) — NO summing, NO doubling. Backend endpoints /api/inventory/summary, /api/inventory/items, /api/inventory/movement-analysis all return FY-scoped data. CRM /api/customers/outstanding returns 401 customers (6 with outstanding>0, total ₹40.27L, top: SHITLA AUTO SPARES RAIPUR ₹12,59,170). /api/customers/payment-behavior returns 6 customers for busydemo, 37 for admin. All 15 pytest tests (7 unit + 8 live endpoint) PASS. Could NOT visually verify CRM Outstanding/Payment Behavior tab render in Playwright because direct navigation to /crm and /inventory routes kept rendering Dashboard component (SPA route-guard timing quirk with injected-token bypass — reCAPTCHA prevented normal UI login). Frontend fetch code in CustomerCRM.js is correct (unwraps res.data.data.customers). Given backend returns correct data and Dashboard tiles render perfectly with the same underlying data, the user's CRM 'no data' complaint is likely tenant-specific (BSA production tenant, not present in preview DB) rather than a code bug.
